༄༅/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i las rim mdor bsdus dngos grub kyi snye ma phrin las kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// 'jam dpal khro bo'i las rim mdor bsdus dngos grub kyi snye ma phrin las kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gu ru ya mān+ta ka na mo/ dang po mtshams bcad pa ni/ thun mong gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med sngon du song bas phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bgegs la gtor mas tshim par byas la/ rang nyid gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs sku mchog yongs rdzogs pa// 'jam dpal 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'jug pa'i skal med mi dang mi ma yin// lha klu la sogs bgegs kyi rigs gyur rnams// rang rang 'dod rgu'i mchod sbyin 'di khyer la// bden pa'i tshig nyon gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i bka' bcag nas// phyogs 'dir 'dug na brlag par the tshom med// hūm̐/ bdag nyid khro rgyal dpal chen 'bar ba yis// sku gsung thugs sprul khro tshogs grangs med 'gyed// bskal pa'i me dpung klong nas hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog /mtshon cha'i char gyis gnod byed thal bar rlog /hūm̐/ snang srid rnam dag ye nas ye shes lha// bde chen chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// rig rtsal ma 'gags lha dang 'drer 'dzin pa'i// log rtog bdud sde'i dpung bcas dbyings su sgrol// oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐/ snod kyi 'jig rten gdod nas gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can rang grub ye shes lha// de nyid rang ngo ma shes sgo bcad pa'i// rang rig rang gsal ye shes sgo phyes shig /bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba kun 'dus snying po rang sems lha/ /gdod nas rang la gnas kyang zhal ma mthong*// de ring ma rig 'khrul pa'i rab rib sangs// rang gsal mjal ba'i brda phyag gus par 'bul// a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐/ dang po me tog phog pa'i yi dam lha// bcom ldan 'jam dpal khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams// da ni rang dang 'bral med rang ngo shes// ma grub bar du mi gtong bsgrub par bgyi// tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/

de nas byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings mkha' ltar rtog bral ngang nyid las// longs spyod rdzogs dang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku /sprin dang char ltar skye 'gro'i re ba skong*// bde gshegs sku mchog yongs rdzogs lha tshogs rnams// spyan 'dren thugs dam dbang gis brtse bas gshegs// sgrub mchog bdag la khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs// dbang bskur byin rlabs dam pa bstsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la byin phob cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ya mān+ta ka ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ā be sha ya a ā/ de nas mchod de/ hūm̐/ rang dang gnyis med lhag pa'i lha// 'jam dpal rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// nam mkha'i mdzod las byung ba yi// lha rdzas mchod sprin gus par 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe sogs/ de nas bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpang gyur tshad ma thams cad dgongs su gsol// bdag gzhan thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// ma rig dbang gis nyes byas gang mchis pa// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshag dag par mdzod// ces yig brgya bzla/ de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ/ ye shes lnga ldan yi ge oṃ// rdor sems rnam snang rin 'byung 'od// don grub yab yum ngo bor bzhugs// spro bsdu zhu bas bdud rtsi che// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ āḥ bde gshegs gsung 'dus skye med a// mchod pa chen po phyag chen po// gzung 'dzin ru ṭa dbyings bsgral pa'i/ khrag chen bde skyed rba klong che// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs srog yi ge hūm̐// snod bcud sbyangs bsgyur spel byin brlabs// 'dod yon phung po mi zad pa// dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma che// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha lin+ta te dzo ba lin+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod rdzas lhag ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/

swā/ yon tan re skong yi ge swā// ci 'dod 'byung ba'i rin chen gter// me tog la sogs sprin phung gtib// nam mkha'i mdzod sogs bla na med// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe sogs/ hā/ las rnams kun 'grub yi ge hā// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// phyi nang gsang mchod lhun gyis grub// srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma tshang med// rū pa sogs/ de nas lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ sems nyid dri med ka nas dag /ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku /blo 'das spros dang bral bar brdal// 'khor 'das ro mnyam kun tu bzang*// oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ hūm̐/ rgyu lam 'bras bu lhan cig skyes// rang la yod pa ma shes par// gzung 'dzin ma rig 'khrul snang la// a 'thas sems can snying re rje// oṃ sarba dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos ni gang yang yod ma yin// dgos 'dod kun 'byung yi ge hūm̐// thams cad skyed pa'i rgyu ru bsgom// tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐/ de las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ chad pa'i// me chu rlung gi 'jig rten stong*// 'byung rim snod bcud sbyang phyir brtsegs// e/ yaṃ/ suṃ/ kaṃ /raṃ/ bh+rūm̐/ 'di rnams rim bzhin yongs su gyur// mtha' dang dbus bral nam mkha' che// g.yo byed stobs ldan sngo ljang rlung*// rak+ta rba klong 'khrug mtsho dmar// kun khyab zhing chen sa brdal bar// rab mtho sra brtan keng rus brjid// 'od ldan bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// sna tshogs rdo rje pad sdong brdal// dur khrod rdor ra me ris bskor// de dbus ye shes gzhal yas khang*// skam rlon thod pa rat+na brtsegs// gnam lcags ngur mo'i gzer chen gdab// klu brgyad ka gdan lha brgyad ka /gza' brgyad ka zhu rgyu skar phyam// mchog chen dral grab zhing lpags thog /rgyu ma'i dra ba dra phyed mdzes// zhing gi rgyal mtshan ba dan phyar// tsit+ta'i pho long rma bya'i gdugs// rin chen tog 'bar dar dpyang spras// nyi ma zla ba'i skar khung gsal// gru chad khyams sgo rta babs sogs// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pho brang dbus// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas// zla gam 'char sgo chos 'byung nang*// chu glang pad+ma nyi zla dang*// dregs pa dgra bgegs gdan khri gsal// ma bcos lhun grub ngo mtshar che// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe ban+dha dzñā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/

ru tra kro dhī ti ra baṃ/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ hūm̐/ ji ltar zla ba lding ba 'am// chu la nya 'phar ji bzhin du// gdan steng skad cig dran rdzogs su// rgyu yi yi ge thugs srog hūm̐// de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid dpal chen gshin rje gshed// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// zhal gdangs rab rno'i mche ba gtsigs// ljags 'dril drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb// spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad// shangs nas hūm̐ dang snyan nas 'brug /drag po'i sgra sgrog srid gsum 'dar/ khro gnyer cher bsdus smin ma dang*// sma ra ag tshom dbu yi skra /dmar ser gyen 'bar me stag dang*// glog dmar rkan sgra'i tshwa tshwa 'phro// thod skam lnga nang bde gshegs lnga// rin chen 'od 'bar dar dpyang sbrul// dbu rgyan mdzes sdug dpa' brjid ldan// zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor thabs bzhengs// g.yas g.yon phyag drug rim pa bzhin// ral gri tho ba gtun shing dang*// lcags kyu sbrul zhags thong gshol bsnams// rigs lnga'i klu dang rus pa yi// snyan cha mgul chu do shal sogs// phyag zhabs sku rgyan mgo rlon ni/ khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan// srin po glang chen g.yang gzhi dang*// stag lpags rlon pas stod smad g.yogs// rgyu ma'i ska rags sked la dkris// sbom thung gsus che yan lag rag /ba spu'i mtshon cha rdo rje'i gshog /'gying brjid dur khrod dpa' chas rdzogs// rab brjid khro gtum rngam pa'i sku /me 'bar gar gyi nyams ldan pa// spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga dang*// lte ba gsang gnas nyi ma'i steng*// 'jam dpal rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /chos rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ste// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lha// dkar dmar mthing ser ljang 'od 'bar// zhal re phyag zhabs gnyis gnyis pa// spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro chas rdzogs// ral gri rdor dbyug rdo rje 'bar// be con rgya gram g.yas na bsnams// g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dor thabs zhabs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan gsal bar bskyed// pang du sbyor yum be tā 'khril// mthing dmar nu ma bha ga rgyas/

khro mo'i chas rdzogs khro 'dzum zhal// g.yas pa gtso 'khyud gri gug dang*// phur bu zhing bcu'i snying la 'debs// g.yon pa bhan+dha bdud rtsi yi/ khrag bkang lcags dral dgra brub rnams// bskal pa'i me klong bzhugs par blta// yab yum thugs las hūm̐ bzhi 'phros// phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du// dregs pa pad nyi ro gdan dbus// sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum gyur// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang// las kyi gshin rje gshed bzhi ni// mthing ser dmar ljang me 'od 'bar// zhal re phyag zhabs gnyis gnyis ldan// rab khro khro bo'i rgyan cha rdzogs// rang rang rigs mtshon be con g.yas// gcod byed 'khor lo g.yon na bsnams// sbyor sgrol yum sbyor yab 'dra'i mdog /khro mo'i rgyan rdzogs gri thod 'dzin// gar gyi nyams ldan gsal bar bskyed// gzhan yang sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs ni/ nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin// bdud 'joms brag 'joms a ba glang*// ya ba phywa sangs rmig pa dang*// tel pa lha mchog 'chi bdag rgyal// mig dmar phyogs skyong gshin rje'i sde// sgo 'dzin ging bdud rtsis bshan rnams// bzhi bzhi'i grangs ldan pho mo bran// sprul pa la sogs mos pas bsgom// phyi rol 'khor yug la gnas pa'i// dur khrod bdag rnams ma lus pa// 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro ging lang ka /dbang phyug 'bar ma ma sring tshogs// phyi nang dregs pa thams cad ni// bsam gyis mi khyab sprin ltar gtib// kun gyis mi sdug gzugs sprul cing*/ kha dog mtshon cha rdzu 'phrul rtsal// ma nges sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur// srid pa'i yang rtse man chad kyi// mthu stobs nus pa gang che yang*// dbang bsdus zil gnon dam la 'dog /bran khol ci bgyis las la 'jug /bka' 'das rdul du brlag byed pa'i// gtso 'khor ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gsal// hūm̐/ ma bcos rang byung ye shes lnga// ma 'gag thugs rje'i rtsal 'byin phyir// rang gsal sku gsung thugs byin brlabs// ye shes lnga dbang lhun grub skur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gu ru ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra dzñā na sarba pañtsa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang dgongs klong skye med las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul sku mchog lha// srid gsum log 'dren bsgral ba'i phyir// 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang mo yum gyi mkhar// rgyal ba gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang*// log rtog sbyang phyir lha tshogs rnams// dbyer med dgyes par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ ye nas chos sku rang bzhin bral// gnyis snang rang 'khrul 'gro ba rnams// gang 'dul der ston lha tshogs la// gnyis med gus par phyag bgyid do// a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// bshos gtsang rol mo mchod sprin che// nam mkha'i mdzod las byung ba rnams// gus 'bul blang dor med par bzhes// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ sogs/ nang mchod ni/ hūm̐/ mdzes ldan dri zhim ro mchog ldan// reg bde zag med yid bzhin sprin// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// 'dod yon phun tshogs mchod pa bzhes// oṃ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ hūm̐/ 'dod khro gti mug nga rgyal che// phrag dog dug lnga sor rtog dang*// me long chos dbyings mnyam nyid grub// rigs lnga dgongs mchod ting 'dzin mchod// hā la pañtsa pū tsa hoḥ hūm̐/ gti mug sha dang 'dod chags khrag /zhe sdang rus pa dug gsum gyi// mchod pa bla med sku gsum dngos// rang grol chen por 'bul lo bzhes// ma hā māṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti pū dza khā hi/ de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal chen yab yum gnyis med kyi// dkar dmar bde chen bdud rtsi che// zag med ye shes dga' bzhi'i rgyun// rang las rang byung rang la 'bul// ma hā su kha gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ

de nas sman mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong sbyar sman// gdod nas rnam dag rang byung bdud rtsi che// rigs lnga sku lnga dam tshig ye shes lnga// lhun grub yongs rdzogs sman mchod dgyes par bzhes// mtshan re re nas bton nas rtsa sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi/ de nas rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid rtsa bdag 'dzin ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag /snod bcud nyi ma dmar cha'i dwangs ma dang*// 'dod chags bde stong ro mnyam byin brlabs pa// 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol phyir 'bul gyis bzhes// snying po'i mthar/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la pū dza khā hi/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ skye med rnam dag klong brdal gtor snod du// 'gag med rang rtsal sna tshogs gtor ma spungs// gnyis med bde ba chen por byin gyis brlabs// 'dod yon thams cad tshim byed mchod par 'bul// de nas gtor ma bsngo/ sngags mthar ma hā ba lin+ta pu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de nas dza gad 'bul/ hūm̐/ ma lus 'bru bcud kun 'dus myos byed la// sbyangs bsgyur spar cing byin brlabs byang chub sems// btung ba'i mchog gyur dza gad bdud rtsi 'di// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor mnyes phyir 'bul// ma hā dza gad pū dza khā hi/ de nas sbyor mchod 'bul/ hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// dbyings rig dbyer med ngang du mnyam par sbyor// brjod bral bde chen rtogs pa'i mchod pa che// blo 'das ngang du spang blang med par 'bul// sarba dharma ma hā mu dra pū dza hoḥ bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ bdag med mtshon cha grub mtha' gcig rtogs pas// ma rtogs log rtog sems can dbyings su bsgral// dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes mchod bla na med// ka dag klong nas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes// shrī ya mān+ta ka ru tra pra bhan tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/ pra be sha ya phaṭa/

ti hūm̐/ e s+pha ra na phaṭa/ ma hā pū dza khā hi/ de nas rdo rje'i glu dang gar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ skye med dbyings las thams cad skyes/ snang tsam nyid nas gzhi rtsa bral// ro mnyam 'du 'bral med par bde// rdo rje'i glu gar mchod pa bzhes// oṃ ma hā dzñā na te te hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te te hūm̐/ de nas dgyes bstod bya ba ni/ dang po don gyi bstod pa/

hūm̐/ ka dag lhun grub ma bcos pho brang nas// spros bral bde chen sku dang ye shes lha// dbyings rig dbyer med rang byung rigs kun gtso// chos sku yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ mtha' bral rnam dag 'od gsal dkyil 'khor du// thugs rje 'gag med zang thal ye shes lha// sna tshogs 'char yang bde chen 'gyur med sku /longs sku yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ rgya chen rnal 'byor thabs mkhas thugs rje'i klong*// rig pa rang rtsal ye shes shar ba'i lha// 'gro 'dul phrin las mtha' dag mthar phyin mdzad// sprul sku yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re ba skong*// thogs med sgyu ma chen po rdzu 'phrul bdag /srid zhir gnas skyon bral ba'i yon tan gter// bde gshegs yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'o// de nas bye brag tu sku mdog rgyan cha'i sgo nas bstod pa/ hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas// ma he pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng*// bde gshegs sku mchog yongs rdzogs gshin rje gshed// mthing nag gtum rngam mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs bsgrad// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khros pa'i zhal// zhal re spyan gsum nyi zla'i sdang mig gzigs// rab gdangs zhal nas rno ngar mche ba gtsigs// ljags 'dril rkan rdeb drag po'i nga ro sgrog /shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin snyan nas 'brug stong ldir/ khro gnyer 'jigs bsdus smin ma sma ra dang*// ag tshom dbu skra bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// ba spu mtshon cha rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs// g.yas kyi dang po ral gris bdag 'dzin gcod// bar pa tho bas dgra bgegs klad rus 'gem// tha ma gtun shing dam nyams rdul du brlag /g.yon gyi dang po lcags kyus srid gsum 'gugs// bar pa zhags pas log 'dren kun nas 'ching*// tha ma thong gshol dgra bo kha zhabs zlog

/glang chen ko rlon stag lpags sham thabs dang*// srin po'i g.yang gzhi klu rgyal sbrul chun spras// thod skam thod rlon phreng ba dbu rgyan dang*// do shal ba su khrag 'dzag srad bus sbrel// rin chen rus rgyan khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan// dur khrod dpal chas yongs rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams// rigs lnga'i rgyas btab rgyal ba'i spyi mes che// ji ltar sprul yang 'gro 'dul phrin las rtsal// gnyis med dgyes yum be tā dza li sbyor// gtso mchog thugs dam skul mdzad sangs rgyas skyed/ khro mo'i rgyan rdzogs khro 'dzum gar dgu'i nyams// gri gug phur bu lcags drwa ban+dha'i phyag /bde stong rol gar zag med phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku mchog rigs kyi lha// 'jam dpal dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chas yongs rdzogs ral gri sdigs mdzub phyag /gti mug chos dbyings ye shes grol phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung mchog rigs kyi lha// rta mchog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chas yongs rdzogs rdor dbyug sdigs mdzub phyag /'dod chags sor rtog ye shes grol phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs mchog rigs kyi lha// phyag rdor mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chas yongs rdzogs rdo rje sdigs mdzub phyag /zhe sdang me long ye shes grol phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan rigs kyi lha// chos rgyal ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chas yongs rdzogs be con sdigs mdzub phyag /nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes grol phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las rigs kyi lha// bdud rtsi ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro chas yongs rdzogs 'khor lo sdigs mdzub phyag /phrag dog bya grub ye shes grol phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka mthing nag khros// dur khrod chas rdzogs sbyor sgrol yum dang bcas// rdo rje be con sdigs mdzub gar dgu'i nyams// zhe sdang 'joms mdzad sras mchog phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/

rat+na ya mān+ta ka ser nag khros// dur khrod chas rdzogs sbyor sgrol yum dang bcas// rin chen be con sdigs mdzub gar dgu'i nyams// nga rgyal 'joms mdzad sras mchog phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ pad+ma ya mān+ta ka dmar nag khros// dur khrod chas rdzogs sbyor sgrol yum dang bcas// pad+ma be con sdigs mdzub gar dgu'i nyams// 'dod chags 'joms mdzad sras mchog phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ karma ya mān+ta ka ljang nag khros// dur khrod chas rdzogs sbyor sgrol yum dang bcas// rgya gram be con sdigs mdzub gar dgu'i nyams// phrag dog 'joms mdzad sras mchog phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ 'gro 'dul rigs bzhi'i sku ston sras mchog bzhi// ya ma rā tsa myos byed me ru tse// tshar dgu yab yum sprul pa yang sprul dang*// bka' sdod pho nyar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul bzhes dgyes par rol// nyes ltung nyams chag kun bshags bsnyen cing bsgrub// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las ma lus pa// dam ldan sngags 'chang bdag gis 'grub mdzad gsol// zhes pas bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ dzap dgongs dang ldan pas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭi wī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ha ya grī ba badz+ra pā ṇi ya ma rā dza/ a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ rat+na ya mān+ta ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pad+ma ya mān+ta ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ karma ya mān+ta ka kro dhi shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ ya ma rak+sha/ ya ma raka a/ ya ma rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhan+dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya tsa/ ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro te ka hūm̐ phaṭa/

bai tā li rak+ṣa mon+ta bh+yo/ e ka dza ṭī traka rak+sha snying kha rag+mo bh+yo/ oṃ ya ma rā dza pre ta tho la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+mo rak+mo snying rtsa la shaṃ bh+yo/ he ma de byi hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma rā dza pre ta byi tri bi mar ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+mo rak+mo khrag la mu sha la bh+yo/ ya ma de byi hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma rā dza pre ta dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+mo rak+mo ting lam ma bh+yo/ nā ga de byi hūṃ/ oṃ ya ma rā dza ka la k+ṣe pre to da ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ma trag rak+mo ru lu bh+yo/ kha raka de byi hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams la/ nad gdon bar chad shān+tiṃ ku ru sogs phrin las gang bsgrub kha bsgyur dang*/ srung dus/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes skabs dang sbyar la ci rigs bzlas pa bya'o// de nas dzap bskul ni/ oṃ/ gzugs snang sku yi rol pa chu zla'i gar// āḥ sgra grags gsung gi rol pa grags stong sngags// hūm̐/ dran rtog thugs kyi rol pa bde stong thugs// ma gsal bar bsgom ma grub bar mi gtang*// zhes skabs su gsal gdab par bya'o/ de nas tshogs mchod ni/ hūm̐/ lha sngags ting 'dzin rang byung rang gsal bas// dngos med dngos por 'dzin zhen raṃ mes bsregs// mtshan med mtshan mar 'dzin zhen yaṃ rlung gtor// gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin zhen khaṃ chus bkrus// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ hūm̐/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyang mkhan rnam rtog tsam// āḥ ye nas 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa bdud rtsi che// oṃ/ zag med 'dod yon phun tshogs snang srid gang// hrīḥ gdod ma'i rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus dgyes// hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ hrīḥ hūm̐/ rang bzhin gnas la mtha' dbus brjod bral phyir// spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod mi 'tshal yang*// ma rig rang rtsal 'gro rnams bsgral slad du// tshogs mchod bzhes phyir spyan 'dren brtse bas gshegs// badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ rgyal rnams 'khrul grol glo bur dri bral yang*// bdag blo sbyang phyir rab mdzes gdan khrir bzhugs// bdag sogs lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal mchod// sdig bshags yi rangs bskul sogs byang chub bsngo// sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma hā ga ṇa pū dza a a/

hūm̐/ mchod yul mchod bya mchod byed mchod bral yang*// sgyu ma chen po'i rol gar 'dod yon spungs// snang dmigs shes byas khyab dang ma khyab pa'i// bla med tshogs phud dbyings nas dbyings 'bul bzhes// ma hā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza khā hi/ hūm̐/ bshags yul bshags bya bshags byed bshags bral yang*// ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs 'khrul dbang gis// phyi nang gsang ba rtsa ba yan lag las// dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung gnong 'gyod bshags// yi ge brgya pa bzlas so// hūm̐/ bskang yul bskang bya skong byed bskang bral yang*// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lhar shar ba'i// gtso 'khor thugs dam gnyan po nongs gyur gang// bla med sbyor sgrol tshogs mchod chen pos bskang*// hūm̐/ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// sum cu rtsa dgu'i lha tshogs thugs dam can// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje be tā yum// yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs dam bskang*// 'jam dpal rta mgrin phyag rdor chos kyi rgyal// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las ye shes lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma yi// ya mān+ta ka gshed bzhi yab yum ni// ya ma rā dza ral gcig rgyas byed gtum// ār+ya 'od zer tshar dgu re ma ti// thugs kyi sras mchog yab yum thugs dam bskang*// nag 'joms re ti phywa sangs gdong dgu ma// brag 'joms shel mig glang mgo mche gtsigs ma// ya ba rngams stabs mig dmar khrag ral can// rmig pa klu mo tel pa spyan gsum mo// bdud 'joms ral gcig 'chi bdag ral pa can// rje dmar ral nag thod dbyug phag mgo ma// phyogs skyong gshin rje yab yum thugs dam bskang*// bya rgod stag dang kang ka spyang ki'i mgo /'gugs 'ching sdom myos sgo srung yab yum dang*// gri thogs ging bzhi khram thogs bdud pho bzhi// srog gcod shan pa bzhi bcas thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/

bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor// ye sgrol ye sbyor chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bdud rtsi dang*// 'khor ba rgyu las sgrol ba'i rak+ta dang/ khyad par rmad byung 'dod yon gtor chen dang*// rnam dag rgyu las bsgral ba'i bam chen dang*// 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba btung ba'i mchog /phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs kyi yo byad kyis// bskang ngo kalpas thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /thun mong phrin las kun 'grub dngos grub stsol// rkyen ngan bar chad ma lus zlog cing sgyur// hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' srung dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs// dam ldan srung skyob dam med rtsad nas gcod// dkyil 'khor mtha' nyul legs nyes stangs 'dzin rnams// rang rang dgyes pa'i 'dod yon du mas bskang*// hūm̐/ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor// ye sgrol ye sbyor chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bdud rtsi dang*// 'khor ba rgyu las sgrol ba'i rak+ta dang*/ khyad par rmad byung 'dod yon gtor chen dang*// rnam dag rgyu las bsgral ba'i bam chen dang*// 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba btung ba'i mchog /phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs kyi yo byad kyis// bskang ngo kalpas thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /thun mong phrin las kun 'grub dngos grub stsol// rkyen ngan bar chad ma lus zlog cing sgyur// de nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba ni/

hūm̐/ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// gtum drag bdud 'dul rab khros mthu stobs bdag /sku yi lha tshogs ma lus sku bzhengs 'tshal// gshed ma'i dmag dpung skar mda' thog ltar skyod// gnad nas bskul lo dgra bgegs da lta khug /'das dang ma 'das srung skyob lha dang phrol// mtshon cha'i char phob lus sems phrol la sod// sha khrag rus pa dug gsum zhal du bzhes// ming tsam med par rdul du rlag par mdzod// dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ de nas bdud rtsi'i gsang nan 'bul ba/ hūm̐/ 'chi med bdud rtsi ye shes ro mchog ldan// rgyu 'bras nad sel sman mchog a mṛ ta// ma lus rgyal ba mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// sarba a mṛta pū dza khā hi/ de nas spyan gzigs thogs/ slob mas/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs ma lus dgongs// nga ni 'dod yon kun 'byung lha mo ste// 'khor 'das ro mnyam tshogs kyi longs spyod 'bul// gnyis 'dzin spangs pa'i ngang nas bde chen rol// ma hā ga ṇa pū dza su kha hoḥ blang ba ni/ hoḥ tshogs mchod 'dod yon phun tshogs ma lus rgyan// zag med dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung*// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pas cho ga bzhin// mi zad bde ba'i gter la longs spyod bya// a la la hoḥ zhes pas rol lo// de nas tshogs lhag ni/ hūm̐/ sbyor dngos rjes tshang 'dod yon phung po'i tshogs// dang po phud bdag dpal chen lha la 'bul// bar du 'khor tshogs lhag ma dgyes par mchod// tha mar chos rnams rgyu 'bras gcig phyir bsre// nga khyod dam tshig 'dres phyir kha chus bran// dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud bran khol ni// dregs pa pho mo ma sring ging laṅka// dur khrod bdag byed bstan dang zhing skyong tshogs// sngon tshe khas blangs dam la ma 'da' bar// lhag gtor 'di longs bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/

de nas chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum dus med ka dag bskal pa la// bcom ldan lhun grub 'jam dpal gshin rje yis/ khregs chod thod rgal chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// glo bur ma rig dregs pa btul ba'i tshe// rtog tshogs gtor ma len par ma chad dam// sku lnga rang ngo shes par ma chad dam// ye shes mthong goms brtan par ma chad dam// chos nyid mngon sum rtogs par ma chad dam// nyams snang gong du 'phel bar ma chad dam// rig pa tshad la phebs par ma chad dam// chos nyid zad sar skyol bar ma chad dam// ngo bo 'gyur med rtogs par ma chad dam// rang bzhin blo thag chod par ma chad dam// rang rtsal thugs rje 'char bar ma chad dam// rang rig ye shes zhal bzhes dran mdzod la// gzhan snang gnyis 'dzin gtor ma 'di bzhes nas// rang grol bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de ltar 'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten tshul// bod khams bstan srung bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas// phyogs mtshams rang rang gnas nas 'dir gshegs la// bka' yi gtor longs khas blangs phrin las sgrubs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛta khā hi/

de nas dam sri mnan pa ni/ gtor gzhong sbubs la/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur 'jigs byed dpal chen sku /chos kyi dbyings las longs sprul skur bzhengs te// stong gsum srid gsum 'dar ba rdo rje'i bro// brdungs pas dgra bgegs dam sri rdul du rlogs// dgra bgegs dam sri oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ mā ra ya nan/ de nas gtor ma sogs dngos grub tu blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum dkon mchog ma lus kun 'dus pa'i// 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// mkhyen brtse nus mthu mthar phyin 'gro ba'i dpal// yid bzhin nor mchog 'dod dgu mi zad gter// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sgo phye nas// zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog dang thun mong kun// mos pa'i bu la dus 'dir myur 'grub pa'i// dngos grub dam pa ma lus bstsal du gsol// sid+dhi pha la sarba hūm̐/ de nas bzod par gsol ba ni/ hoḥ bdag sogs ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin ma 'grub sogs// lhag chad nor 'khrul nyes tshogs gang mchis pa// mkhyen mnga'i lha la mthol bshags bzod par bzhes// he ru ka'i yig brgya dang*/ dbyangs gsal gyis kha skong ngo*// de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las byung*// bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos srung nor lha dam can rgya mtsho bcas// mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba gcig bsdus 'jam dpal gyi// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kun la khyab// 'gyur med 'gag med 'khrul med re ba skong*// thogs med ci bsam don 'grub bkra shis shog / ces pa dang*/ rgyas pa gzhan nas kha bskang ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐/ skye med dbyings las 'gag med skur shar ba'i// gang 'dul cho 'phrul ston mdzad sku mchog lha// smin grol chos 'khor 'gro ba ma lus 'dul// slar yang chos dbyings skye med dbyings su bsdu'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ

de nas rgyun gyi spyod lam ni/ hūm̐/ 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu zhen med lus// ngar 'dzin rnam dag rang byung dpal chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab dus kun du// thabs shes zung 'brel 'gro 'dul spyod lam bya'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hrīḥ de nas bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum phun tshogs dge spyad mthus// 'gro kun skyon dag yon tan gong du rdzogs// smin grol lam la goms pa mthar phyin te// sku gsum lhun grub sangs rgyas thob par shog /gnas skabs su yang 'jig rten ma lus bde// bstan 'dzin thams cad sku khams bzang ba dang*// sems can thams cad chos bzhin spyod 'gyur zhing*// mthar thug 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho myur skem shog /bsngo bya sngo byed bsngo ba mi dmigs pa// 'khor 'das kun bzang klong du ro gcig pa'i/ chos dbyings zab mo bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngo ba'i smon pa 'grub par shog / phrin las mdor bsdus dngos grub kyi snye ma'i zin bris re zhig rdzogs so// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /'di mnyam nyid rdo rje'i gsung du tshur par dkar chag las gsal// //
